artworks.title: Portrait of a Bearded Man with a Beret
artworks.medium: colored chalks on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Stephen M. Kellen, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a close-up illustration of a man's face, focusing on his head and part of his shoulders. The man's head is turned slightly to the side, showcasing his strong, prominent nose, expressive eyes, high cheekbones, and relaxed mouth. He has a full beard, mustache, and slightly curly hair peeking from under his cap. The man is wearing a simple cap and a hint of a shirt collar is visible around his neck. The background is a plain, light surface with subtle stains.

artworks.title: David and Bathsheba
artworks.medium: pen and black ink and gray wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Elmar W. Seibel, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a circular scene resembling an etching. An elevated viewpoint shows a nude figure seated on the ground interacting with another draped figure. Architectural elements such as columns, sculptures, and curtains are present. Additionally, there is a fountain spraying water upward. In the background are faded urban structures including a dome and a spire-like building. The fine brushstrokes and detailed line work create texture and depth using a sepia color palette, giving the image an antique look.

artworks.title: Winter Landscape with Skaters
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink and wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Robert H. and Clarice Smith, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image features a winter scene with numerous people skating and socializing on a frozen river. In the distance, there is a village with several small church towers. The drawing is meticulous, with fine linework capturing details like architecture, people, and bare trees. The color palette is warm sepia, creating a vintage effect. Closest to the viewer, figures are engaging in various winter activities. Further into the distance, tall trees line the river's edge, leading the eye to more buildings and natural elements in the background.

artworks.title: Landscape with Figures by an Estuary with Sailing Boats
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink on laid paper; laid down
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. David P. Tunick, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This image features a drawing of a waterside scene. The horizon is low with the water meeting the land and various structures. In the composition, there is a sailboat on the left, buildings on the right, and a figure near the water's edge. The drawing style uses delicate linework with monochromatic brown tones. Other small boats are visible in the distance on the calm water.

artworks.title: The March of Silenus [recto]
artworks.medium: red, black, and white chalks on brown laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Shepard Morgan to honor Margaret Morgan Grasselli, Curator of Old Master Drawings, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts multiple figures in a tightly composed group. Most figures are shown from the waist up, with some partially obscured by others. The people are positioned closely together, interacting with one another, with several facing different directions and appearing to be in motion. The facial features and hair of the individuals are depicted using loose and expressive lines, suggesting a variety of expressions and hair made with flowing lines. They are wearing draped garments rendered with fluid lines and shading, contributing to the sense of movement and interaction. The figures do not appear to be holding any objects or wearing discernible jewelry. The background is minimal, providing no distinct landscape or interior setting, allowing the focus to remain on the dynamic arrangement of figures. The artwork is done with a combination of red and black chalk, creating a vivid and energetic composition.

artworks.title: Figure Sketches and a Copy After a Sculpted Head [verso]
artworks.medium: red chalk on brown laid paper, the sculpted head likely not by Watteau
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Paul Shepard Morgan to honor Margaret Morgan Grasselli, Curator of Old Master Drawings, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a sketched drawing of the head and upper torso of a figure, with flowing lines indicating hair. The facial features imply a profile slightly turned to one side, with eyes, nose, and lips. A smaller figure, possibly a cherub or putto, is near the main figure's face with outstretched arms. The sketch is done with red chalk on light brown paper, with a textured surface. In the upper left corner, there is another lightly sketched figure or object. Faint outlines of more figures or decorative elements surround the head. The background is not detailed, focusing solely on the outlined figures in a classical style illustration.

artworks.title: La malheureuse famille Calas  (The Unfortunate Calas Family)
artworks.artist: Jean-Baptiste Delafosse, after Louis de Carrogis, called Carmontelle
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 36 x 45.8 cm (14 3/16 x 18 1/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a group of seven individuals in an interior setting. On the left side, two men are shown: one is leaning over a table with papers and a quill, while the other stands upright. The central figure is a woman with her hands clasped at her waist. To the right are two women and a young girl seated beside the central figure. They all wear 18th-century attire. The background features stone walls, steps, and a small barred window, along with a chain attached to the wall.

artworks.title: Head of a Gentleman [recto]
artworks.medium: red, black, and white chalks with stumping on brown paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien in memory of Genevieve Aymonier, and in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a close-up portrait of a person's upper torso and head. The person is positioned at a slight angle, with their head turned towards the viewer. They have delicate facial features, including softly arched eyebrows, large eyes, a straight nose, and slightly parted lips. The individual has light-colored, curly hair styled back with a ribbon visible at the back of the head. They are dressed in historical clothing, possibly a high-collared garment or cape. The background is plain and neutral, emphasizing the subject's facial features and expression.

artworks.title: Antoine Coypel and His Son
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a man and a young girl seated in an intimate setting. The man is holding a paintbrush and palette, with an easel nearby. He has distinctive curls in his long hair and is wearing a flowing garment. The girl is seated beside him, looking towards the man. She has elaborate hair and wears an elegant dress. The background features a wall filled with books and wooden panel flooring.

artworks.title: Joseph Parrocel
artworks.artist: Johann Georg Wille after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image is an engraved portrait depicting the upper body of a man facing slightly to his left. He has long, curly hair, a prominent nose, and a composed expression. The man is wearing a patterned robe with a white cravat around his neck. The background features an oval frame with intricate detailing resembling stone or a textured surface. Below the portrait, there is a decorative plaque with text, and a crest or coat of arms is located just below the oval frame.

artworks.title: Louis Tocque
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image displays a man from the waist up, positioned to his left. He has light, curly hair and a calm expression. He wears a formal coat with detailed buttons and an ornate neckpiece. He holds paintbrushes in his right hand and a painter's palette in his left. The background features a stone-like oval frame within a rectangular border.

artworks.title: Francois Verdier
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a man seated with a slight smile, looking forward. He has distinct facial features and is wearing a cap and a loose-fitting garment draped over his shoulders. Beside him are a drawing board and drawing tools. The background features a stone arch. Below the portrait is a plaque with the name "François Verdier" and professional distinctions.

artworks.title: Joseph Vernet
artworks.artist: Louis-Jacques Cathelin after Louis Michel Van Loo
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The portrait depicts the upper half of a man's body. The man is slightly turned to his left, with his gaze directed towards the viewer. His facial features are sharp and distinguished with a calm expression, high forehead, arched eyebrows, and well-defined cheekbones. His hair is short, wavy, and styled back. He is wearing a detailed coat with lace trimming at the collar and cuffs. The man holds a paintbrush and palette. The portrait is set in an ornate oval frame with intricate pattern designs. The background is a simple gradient. Below the portrait is a nameplate with the name "Joseph Vernet."

artworks.title: Nicholas Boileau
artworks.artist: François Chereau I after Hyacinthe Rigaud
artworks.medium: engraving and etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: This is a portrait showing the upper body of a man, depicted from the chest up. He is positioned slightly turned to his left but looking forward, with a slight, content expression on his face. The man has deep-set eyes, a Roman nose, long, voluminous, curly hair cascading down to his shoulders, and is wearing a robe or cloak with a visible ruffled or cravat collar. The background is a plain, subtly textured surface.

artworks.title: Pierre Louis Moreau de Maupertuis
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of John O'Brien
artworks.description: The image shows a person in elaborate clothing seated next to a column with one arm on a globe and the other arm pointing outward. The individual has a focused expression with defined facial features, curly dark hair, and light skin. They are wearing fur-trimmed clothing with intricate patterns, a fur hat, and a belt with an ornate medallion. The background features architectural elements, a drape, stone arches, and a landscape with mountains and smoke. In the lower portion of the image, there is a canoe with a person and a likely reindeer.

artworks.title: A Young Man with a Staff
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Kate Ganz, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image is a sketch of a person seen from behind, in a walking or gesturing pose. The figure has curly hair, and their right arm is extended forward. The clothing is depicted with loose strokes to show folds and movement. The background is plain. The sketch has a rough and expressive style with strong lines and shading.

artworks.title: The Death of Saint Joseph
artworks.medium: watercolor, graphite, and charcoal on wove paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Louisa C. Duemling, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This painting shows a man lying on a bed attended by people with halos of light around their heads. The man is laying horizontally, his head on the right and his feet towards the left. He has a beard, a white cloth over his curly hair, and a white garment on, and his hands are clasped upright on his chest. His lower body and legs are beneath a textured blue blanket. A man and a woman are by his head, holding him. They are both robed in white, and the man has brown hair and a brown beard, while the woman has a long cloth covering her hair. All three people have white skin with hints of pale pink, light blue, and gray. Above the three people, an arched rainbow stretches across the top of the painting. Within the rows of red, orange, yellow, green, blue, and pink are faint cherubic faces surrounded by wings, all looking down. The background is dark, with lines radiating outward from the three people.

artworks.title: Composition de F. Millet (Composition by F. Millet)
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper (facing _Composition de F. Millet_ by Albert Merat)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Richard A. Simms, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing upright. Their head is slightly tilted downwards, gazing at the ground or the object they are holding. Their facial features are not detailed, and their hair is mostly covered by a wide-brimmed hat. The individual wears a long-sleeved garment, a long skirt, and flat shoes. They hold a spindle wrapped with fibers in their right hand. The background features gentle hills and grazing animals, likely sheep or goats, giving a rural setting. The artwork is textured, with lines creating depth in the figure and landscape.

artworks.title: L'Eclair (Lightning)
artworks.medium: etching in black on laid paper (facing _L'Eclair_ by Paul Meurice)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Richard A. Simms, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with ruins and rugged terrain. The viewpoint is slightly elevated. The horizon is placed in the upper third of the composition with tall, dark structures against the night sky. The artwork uses intricate cross-hatching and line work for texture and shadows. The color palette is monochromatic in black and white, enhancing contrast. There are rough formations and remnants of walls or arches nearby, leading towards the distant structures. The background features a thickly inked sky.

artworks.title: Fleur Exotique (Exotic Flower)
artworks.medium: etching and aquatint in black on laid paper (facing _Fleur Exotique_ by Armand Renaud)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Richard A. Simms, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts a woman from the waist up. She is slightly turned to the side, facing the viewer. The woman has distinct facial features, long dark hair, and is wearing a dark gown with a shawl or wrap covering her shoulders. She is holding a folding fan and a small bouquet of flowers. The background is a textured stippling.

artworks.title: The End (La Fin de Tout)
artworks.medium: etching with chalk additions in red on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image shows three individuals. One person is lying down with their head on a pillow, covered by a blanket. Another individual stands near the bed, facing the person lying down. In the background, there is a candleholder on the wall with a lit candle, casting light in the room. Another figure is partially visible, peering from a corner on the right side.

artworks.title: The End (La Fin de Tout)
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: The image depicts three figures in an interaction. One figure is lying in a reclined position on a bed, their head supported by a cushion. Another figure is standing beside them, leaning over with a gentle posture. The reclining figure has a relaxed facial expression and long, dark hair, with closed eyes. The standing figure wears a draped cloak, partially covering their head and their hands rest on the reclining figure's arm. Surrounding them are additional figures—one seated at the foot of the bed with a downcast face, while another stands holding an object. The room is dimly lit with a simple wall, and a candle illuminates the scene from above, creating intricate light and shadow patterns. The figures are dressed in simple, flowing garments, enhancing the somber and tranquil atmosphere of the setting.

artworks.title: The Suicide (Le Suicide)
artworks.medium: etching in black with plate tone on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: This is a print of a person crouched on the edge of a bridge with a road on the left, with a horse-drawn cart passing over it and the skyline of a city in the distance. The road stretches into the distance, bordered by the outlines of tall buildings. The person in the center is hunched over, with their head resting on their arms, as they sit on the edge of what appears to be a bridge or elevated path. The edge of the bridge falls off in a sheer drop toward the bottom-right corner, and we can’t see what is below it.

artworks.title: The Suicide (Le Suicide)
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, and printed tone on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Mr. and Mrs. Daniel Bell, in Honor of the 50th Anniversary of the National Gallery of Art
artworks.description: An individual is seated on a sloped surface, possibly a riverbank or a bridge. They are hunched over with their head resting on their arms and supported by their knees. The person's face is obscured from view, with their hair falling over their shoulders. They are wearing a dark, voluminous garment and there are no visible accessories or objects in their hands. The scene is dimly lit, suggesting an evening or nighttime setting. In the background, a street extends into the distance with an old-fashioned horse-drawn carriage moving along it. Streetlamps line the road and a city skyline is visible in the distance.
